requirements.text: The system shall support an Apply for loan via agent flow.

evidence.source_span: Flow: Apply for loan via agent

requirements.text: The system shall receive loan application input via the api gateway.

evidence.source_span: Arrow: loan application input -> api gateway

requirements.text: The api gateway shall forward loan requests to the loan agent.
The api gateway shall interface with the ssn vault for SSN handling.
The loan agent shall retrieve supporting data from the db.
The loan agent shall obtain identity information from unified identity.
The loan agent shall invoke a credit check as part of loan evaluation.
The loan agent shall route loan decisions to final human (manager) review.

evidence.source_span: Arrow: loan agent -> final human (manager) review

requirements.text: The loan agent shall write processing events to the audit log.
The loan agent shall accept submit request actions.
The system shall capture and store the applicant name.
The system shall handle the applicant ssn as sensitive PII data.
The system shall capture and store the applicant email.
The system shall capture and store the type-loan.
The system shall capture and store the loan description.
The system shall handle applicant identities.
The system shall associate loan requests with a loan_provider.
The system shall include an api gateway component.
The system shall include a loan agent component.
The system shall include an ssn vault component for isolated SSN storage.
The system shall include a db component for persistence.
The system shall integrate with a credit check service.
The system shall integrate with a unified identity service.
The system shall provide an audit log store.
The system shall require authentication before accepting loan application input via the api gateway.
The system shall verify requester ownership of identities via unified identity before loan agent processing.
The api gateway shall validate loan application input including name, email format, ssn format, type-loan and description and reject invalid input.
SSN data shall be stored and retrieved only via the ssn vault with encryption and restricted access, and shall not be stored in plaintext in db or audit log.
Only users in an authorized manager role shall complete final human (manager) review decisions.
The audit log shall be append-only and record actor, action, and timestamp for loan agent events without storing full SSN.
The loan agent invocation of credit check shall use least-privilege credentials and shall not expose full SSN beyond what is required.

assumptions.A1: Loan flow handles PII (name, ssn, email) and financial decisions; authentication is implied to prevent anonymous submissions.
assumptions.A2: Presence of identities and unified identity feeding loan agent implies ownership/identity proofing is required to prevent impersonation.
assumptions.A3: External loan application input implies need for input validation to prevent injection and malformed data.
assumptions.A4: SSN is highly sensitive PII and a dedicated ssn vault plus separate db/audit log implies segregation and protection is required.
assumptions.A5: Final human manager review gate implies role-based authorization is needed to prevent unauthorized approvals.
assumptions.A6: Presence of audit log in a PII/financial flow implies tamper-evident accountability logging with PII minimization is required.
assumptions.A7: Credit check access from loan agent handling SSN implies need for authorized, minimized disclosure to external service.
